Name: A Moth's Inner Compass - Custom NPC Aurel
Author: CaptainWolfe11
Description:
[left]﻿[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/nDBWqy3.png[/img][/center][/left]She's recently moved to the valley to pursue her passion for studying butterflies and moths, which are unfortunately absent where she comes from. But she's hiding a little secret, and she doesn't know if she'll be able to keep living in the valley for long without it getting out. Cheerful, calm, and generally optimistic, this secret worry is a blindspot she might need a little help with. 

Aurel has a complete storyline, with 13 heart events over 10 heart levels. She's good friends with Willy, Emily and Linus, and has her own living area accessible via boat from the beach. She attends festivals and has randomized seasonal dialogue, so she will have a lot of new things to say as time goes on. 

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/iwQAOLW.png[/img][/center]
Aurel will have 20 new dialogue lines per each of the following mods that you have installed : [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13883]Eli and Dylan[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10950]Jorts and Jean the Helper Cats[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url], spread out over heart levels and the seasons. She also reacts to NPCs from other expansions as well.

Besides a patch extending the leftmost dock on the beach, this mod doesn't touch any maps or change anything about NPCs. I've tested it with SVE and East Scarp and made sure everything worked well. [s]As of v 1.0.7, this mod no longer conflicts with FIASA or Cape Stardew[/s]  [u]As of 1.1.0, there is a configuration option that lets you move Aurel's boat on the beach for maximum compatibility with a variety of mods[/u]!

For festivals, I attempted to make sure she wouldn't overlap with NPCs from Rigeside, Sunberry Village, and the most popular expansions. Let me know if any issues arise!

There's a config setting that allows you to use portraits for Aurel that match the style of Nyapu's portraits. These are portraits I frankenstein-ed together myself, and not original Nyapu art, but I made them because Nyapu has been very generous with their use restrictions and thought it would be nice to have as a Nyapu portrait lover myself. If Nypau ever happens to make art for this mod, I'll be removing my edits and replacing them with the real deal! 

Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for easy config editing.

This mod is was created in English, but has an i18n file for translations. If any translations do get added, I'll link them here. For translators: If you want to translate this mod, feel free to upload the translation yourself (only the i18n file!) or send it to me to include in the mod with credit, whatever works best for you! Please no machine translation.

[b][color=#f4cccc]Minor Compatibility Notes:[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*]This mod adds a number of crops and goods, and I tried to make sure there was no overlap with other crop expansions. However, I didn't realize Maypop fruit and Passionfruit were one and the same, so if you have this mod and Cornucopia installed you will have two kinds of Passionfruit. It shouldn't cause any problems!
[*]There might be some narrative dissonance if you are playing as a mermaid farmer or with characters that are openly accepted as real-life mermaids by the townsfolk.
[*]This mod doesn't directly conflict with mods that let the farmer marry Willy (but maybe avoid if you're the jealous type lol)
[/list]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/vosZhgK.png[/img][/center]This mod also adds 3 new flower crops, two bushes using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20619]Custom Bush[/url], two fruit trees, and one wild tree - all of which are varietals that butterflies love in real life! Two recipes are also added which use the new products. It also adds a silkworm hutch, which will provide you with (ruptured!) silk cocoons you can put in a loom to craft (cruelty free!) silk, which is an artisan good similar to, but more profitable, than cloth. Currently silk can't be used in tailoring, but you can transmute it into 2 cloth if you like.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/dTDoPJx.png[/img][/center]Plans I currently have for this mod include:

[list]
[*]More events with villagers post her 10 heart event
[*]Moving to the Valley and rooming with Willy 
[*]Expanded dialogue referencing more custom NPCs
[*]Optional extended dialogue for Willy
[/list]
In general, I plan to keep adding to this mod over time. This is my first NPC mod and I learned a lot during the process of making it, and I'm sure things will pop up that I want to implement in the future. 

Please report any bugs or issues you have or typos! I've never made a mod this big before and I'm sure I missed something, and would like to continually improve upon it.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/ZWX77TE.png[/img][/center][list=1]
[*]Download and install SMAPI, Content Patcher, Custom Bush, and crystalinerose's Tilesheets.
[*]Download the .zip file for this mod.
[*]Unzip the .zip file for this mod.
[*]Drop the unzipped folder into your Mods folder.
[*](Optional) Change the config settings if you wish.
[*]Play!
[/list]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/WnZpYXJ.png[/img][/center]I highly recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1965]Elle's Town Animals[/url] by junimods, which lets you configure all of the butterflies in the game to be unique and beautiful variants of real-life butterfly species. Though the mod has not been officially updated for 1.6, it continues to work just fine. (I was originally going to add butterfly variants to this mod, but I don't think I could ever do better than junimods!). Or, if you are going for a more witchy vibe, I recommend Bog's newly released [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36438]Moth Hutch and Critters[/url] mod, which turns the butterflies in the game into pretty moths. 

The dialogue in this mod was written with Haywrites' expanded dialogue for Willy in mind. You can find it in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30959]Haywrite's All-In-One Dialogue Expansion[/url], which I recommend! 

And of course, I thoroughly recommend the four mods I wrote expanded dialogue for that I linked above. They are all mods I can't play without, and felt confident enough to write some dialogue referencing - but more than that they are all just extremely good.
